About.Title: About
About.PageDescription: Learn more about who I am and what I do.
About.Hacker: I started IT career in 2019, as an ethical hacker. But I haven't been doing anything about cyber security since 2022. I am currently a software developer, working on web applications.
About.Developer: I'm a passionate software developer and technology enthusiast dedicated to creating innovative digital solutions. With expertise in modern web technologies and a focus on user experience, I build applications that make a meaningful impact.
About.Musician: I make music as a hobby. Raised in China and United States, I was interested in pop, rock, and hip-hop music from a young age. I started my music career as a DJ in the band of his high school, which is Beijing Haidian Foreign Language Shi Yan School, before I began producing my own music. Inspired by Lil Pump and Juice WRLD, I began to make hip-hop music. Now, I makes different genres of music, including EDM, hip-hop, lo-fi, emo rap, trap, and rock.
About.Designer: I also design as a hobby. I have designed a lot of different brands, including logos, websites, and social media profiles. With my music and design skills, I have also designed for individual artists, including their album covers and posters.
